name: Reckless Wand Wielder
body:
By drawing out more power than you should, you can produce stronger effects from wands.

Prerequisite(s): Craft Wand, Use Magic Device 3 ranks.

Benefit: As a full round action when using a wand to cast a spell you can expend 2 charges rather than one and treat the caster level of the wand as your character level to maximum caster level of 10. For example a 7th level character with this feat could expend two charges from a wand of fireball to treat the caster level as 7 for the effect and the fireball would deal 7d6 damage rather than 5d6.
